description: Reactor dispatch engine counters for MDS stall and backlog investigation. Most panels use PRIO_USEFUL/INTERESTING metrics exported by default (exporter_prio_limit=5). The Replies panel requires ceph-exporter exporter_prio_limit=0 because ceph_mds_reply is PRIO_DEBUGONLY.

panels.description: Current depth of the single-threaded MDSOpWorkQueue.
panels.title: Dispatch Queue Depth - $mds_servers

panels.description: High water mark since last reset. A large max with queue depth near zero indicates the reactor fell behind and later drained (idle stall pattern).
panels.title: Dispatch Queue High Water Mark - $mds_servers

panels.description: Replies (ceph_mds_reply) are PRIO_DEBUGONLY and only exported when ceph-exporter runs with exporter_prio_limit=0.
panels.title: Client Request / Caps / Reply Rate - $mds_servers

panels.description: Time messages waited in MDSOpWorkQueue before execution (Prometheus exports PERFCOUNTER_TIME in seconds as seconds via PERFCOUNTER_TIME). Lane order: Control > IOComplete > Maintenance > Client.
panels.title: Enqueue Wait Latency by Lane - $mds_servers
Execute Latency by Lane - $mds_servers
panels.description: Time spent executing an op on the reactor thread under mds_lock (PERFCOUNTER_TIME values are seconds as seconds via PERFCOUNTER_TIME).
Per-message-type reactor execute time for Control-lane inbound messages. Use this to see which control ops dominate dispatch_execute_latency_control.
panels.title: Execute Latency by Control Work Class - $mds_servers

panels.description: Breakdown of CEPH_MSG_CLIENT_SESSION execute time on the renewcaps hot path. Full client_session series is the reactor work-class counter; the mds_server series time get_session, touch_session, and RENEWCAPS reply build+send.
panels.title: Client Session / RENEWCAPS Path Breakdown - $mds_servers

panels.description: Execute time for Maintenance inbound messages and synthetic work (trim_quantum, log_trim, advance_queues, io_completion, callable). TrimQuantum/LogTrim are time-sliced (mds_*_trim_max_duration) and single-flight; long holds should be rare.
panels.title: Execute Latency by Maintenance / Synthetic Work Class - $mds_servers

panels.description: Effective wall-clock slice budget after dominant-backlog adaptation. Control is not adapted. 0 means drain-until-empty for that visit.
panels.title: Effective Lane Slice (ms) - $mds_servers

panels.description: Per-lane MDSOpWorkQueue depth for adaptable lanes.
panels.title: Lane Queue Depth (adaptable) - $mds_servers

panels.description: Estimated backlog = queue_depth * rolling avg execute time. Adaptation uses the dominant (max) adaptable backlog vs soft target.
panels.title: Estimated Lane Backlog - $mds_servers

panels.description: Rolling average execute time per adaptable lane (us) and Client enqueue throttle waiters (threads blocked on high watermark).
panels.title: Lane Avg Execute / Client Enqueue Throttle - $mds_servers

panels.description: Rate of Client-lane enqueue backpressure wait entries (dispatch_client_enqueue_throttle_waits).
panels.title: Client Enqueue Throttle Wait Entries - $mds_servers

panels.description: Cache trim ticks deferred because the maintenance lane was starved. Non-zero rate under load suggests trim starvation.
panels.title: Cache Trim Throttle Rate - $mds_servers

title: MDS Reactor Dispatch
